I am 67 years old and have been farming these sandy soils of Mtwara all my life. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive and hard to find in our area, so my maize grows with the rains and whatever manure I can collect from my goats and chickens. I save my own seed from last season and plant it the way my mother taught me, alongside cassava or beans, and I do not buy sprays because they cost too much for a food crop. I rely on my children and grandchildren to help with the hoe work, though I may need to hire a few young men when the clearing and harvest are heavy.
